results.description:
*Make sure to read the important notice at the end to check if your device is supported before playing Don't Starve Together!*

Fight, Farm, Build and Explore Together in the standalone multiplayer expansion to the uncompromising wilderness survival game, Don't Starve.

Enter a strange and unexplored world full of odd creatures, hidden dangers, and ancient secrets. Gather resources to craft items and build structures that match your survival style. Play your way as you unravel the mysteries of "The Constant". Cooperate with your friends in a private game, or find new friends online. Work with other players to survive the harsh environment, or strike out on your own.

Survive together stranded on a gloomy world full of surprises and mysteries, and craft your way out through the darkness. Do whatever it takes, but most importantly, Don't Starve.

FEATURES
– Do what you can to survive in this spooky and cartoonish world and choose between a large catalog of characters with their own backstory and playstyle.
– There’s safety in numbers: these lands are full of dangers and monsters so your odds are greater surrounded by friends in local co-op or online partners you meet along the way.
– Tend to your needs: build a settlement, farm and hunt for food, craft better gear to defend yourself and go in expedition but don’t forget to take a break in the flowers once in a while or you’ll start to lose your mind!
– Who put you in these dangerous surroundings, and why? You’ll need to explore "The Constant" and crack its puzzling mysteries to find out and escape this gloomy place.
– Play your own way: pick the mode you prefer to adjust the difficulty by tweaking a large panel of parameters.
– Choose from a large variety of cosmetic items for your favorite characters: survive, but in style! (available in in-app purchases)

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
– Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
– Game Center achievements
– Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
– Compatible with MFi controllers
– iPhone 17 Optimization (including Pro Max)

*IMPORTANT NOTICE*
Due to limited RAM, the following devices may not provide a stable experience and the game may not run as smoothly as intended:
- iPhone XR, iPhone SE (2nd Gen, 2020)
- iPad Mini (5th Gen), iPad Air (3rd Gen), iPad (8th & 9th Gen)
For the best experience, we do not recommend playing on these models.
